svg.title: KV-cache sharing in MHA, GQA, MQA, and MQA with Cross-Layer Attention
svg.desc: Two adjacent layers with four query heads per layer. MHA caches four KV head histories per layer; GQA caches two; MQA caches one. Pairwise Cross-Layer Attention combined with MQA shares one KV history between both layers, while their queries remain independent. Lines indicate which history a query head uses, rather than execution order.
svg.text: One KV head per query head
One KV head per group of query heads
Each layer keeps its own queries
All panels: two adjacent layers, four query heads per layer, the same sequence length and head dimension.
